title: आर्थिक कूटनीतिः अवधारणा र अभ्यास: Economic Diplomacy: Concepts and Practices
nepali: शक्ति र सम्पत्तिको पारस्परिक अन्तर्परिवर्तन अर्थात् कूटनीतिक कौशलद्वारा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय जगत्‌सँग आफ्नो राष्ट्रको आर्थिक हित प्रवर्धन गर्न वा आर्थिक शक्तिको प्रयोगद्वारा कूटनीतिक उद्देश्यहरू प्राप्त गर्न सञ्‍चालन गरिने गतिविधिहरूको समष्टि रूप आर्थिक कूटनीति हो । यसको माध्यमबाट देशको अर्थतन्त्रलाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अर्थव्यवस्थासँग तादात्म्य र सामञ्जस्य कायम गर्ने तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा उपलब्ध अवसरहरूलाई राष्ट्रहितमा प्रयोग गर्ने एवम् राष्ट्रिय हित अनुकूल परिस्थिति सिर्जना गर्ने प्रयत्न गर्दछ । व्यापार घाटा न्यूनीकरण, निर्यात प्रवर्धन, आयात प्रतिस्थापन, पर्यटन क्षेत्रको प्रवर्धन, वैदेशिक रोजगारी, सरकारी विकास सहायताको परिचालन, गैरआवासीय नेपालीहरूको ज्ञान, सिप, प्रविधि र पुँजी राष्ट्रिय विकासमा उपयोग एवम् वैदेशिक लगानी तथा प्रविधि हस्तान्तरण लगायतका क्षेत्रमा आर्थिक बिक्री कौशल, आर्थिक र व्यापारिक सञ्जालको निर्माण, यथेष्ट प्रचारप्रसार, छवि निर्माण र वकालतका लागि आर्थिक कूटनीतिको कुशलतापूर्वक संयोजन र सञ्चालन गर्न आवश्यक छ ।
american_english: Economic diplomacy is the totality of the activities that are carried out through diplomatic skill to promote one's own country's economic interests or to achieve economic diplomatic objectives through the use of economic power. Through this, the country attempts to bring about a balance and harmony between the economy and the international economic order, and to use the opportunities available at the international level for the nation's benefit, as well as to create a favourable environment for national interests. It is necessary to skilfully combine and carry out economic trade skills, the establishment of economic and trade networks, the best promotion and publicity, image-building and advocacy for economic sales, and other such matters.
british_english: Economic diplomacy is the aggregate of those activities undertaken by means of diplomatic expertise to promote one's own country's economic interests or to attain economic diplomatic objectives through the use of economic power. Through this, the country seeks to secure a balance and harmony between the economy and the international economic order, as well as to make use of the opportunities available at international level for the nation's gain, and to create a conducive situation for national interests. It is essential that economic trading skills, the setting up of an economic and trading network, optimal promotion, publicity, image-building and lobbying for the economic trade be skilfully combined and operated.
australian_english: Economic diplomacy is the whole lot of the activities done through diplomatic know-how to push your own country's economic interests or to get economic diplomatic objectives through the use of economic muscle. Through this, the country goes about trying to strike a balance and get some harmony between the economy and the international economic order, and to make use of the opportunities that are floating about at the international level for the good of the nation, and to put in place a decent environment for national interests. You need to skilfully bring together the economic trade know-how, set up an economic and trading network, do the best promotion and publicity you can, build up the image and put the economic trade out there, and all that kind of thing.
informal_english: So economic diplomacy is basically all the stuff a country does through its diplomatic skills to push its own economic interests or to score some economic diplomatic goals using economic muscle. Through that, the country tries to get a balance and sort out some harmony between the economy and the international economic order, and use the opportunities doing the rounds internationally for the good of the nation, and set up a nice environment for national interests. You gotta skilfully mix all that economic trading know-how, set up the economic and trading network, do the best promo you can, build the image and get the economic trade moving.
